Due to a quirk in the spawning mechanics, when it is day, Flutter Mane will spawn and despawn so rapidly that they will not appear visible to the player at all, unless the player is in a Union Circle session, in which case they will appear briefly. This behavior does not apply to Flutter Mane, as Shiny Pokémon are immune to being despawned by such mechanics, nor does it apply during night.
